crossRefs.note: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

parallels.note: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

people.name: Amminadab
people.line: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David

people.name: Nahshon
people.line: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Salmon
people.line: Son of Nahshon; husband of Rahab; ancestor of David

translations.web: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,
translations.bsb: Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, Nahshon was the father of Salmon,
translations.kjv: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
